lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots. Directly posterior to the gills, a column of five distinct spots is visible, followed by subsequent columns forming a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are discernible, aligning with the centers of the circular spots, creating a lattice structure with horizontal rows of spots.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single, pronounced horizontal linear feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and lower-intensity pixels on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) in close proximity to the ventral surface and one overlapping the posterior gill slits.
